create_Callback: create a thread-safe Callback object that waits for and returns a value when invoked
test_Handler_unary_unary: test the _Handler handle_unary_unary method to echo back a unary request with trailing metadata
test_Handler_stream_stream: test the _Handler handle_stream_stream method to echo each streamed request as a streamed response
test_GenericHandler_routing: test the _GenericHandler service method to route RPC calls to the correct handler by method name
test_BaseRPCTest_lifecycle: test the BaseRPCTest setUp and tearDown methods to start and stop a gRPC test server with an insecure channel
